summary: Validated iteration-3 share-card feature end-to-end + regression for useCallback/Recharts polish. Added /app/backend/tests/test_og_share.py (6 new tests) and ran full pytest suite: 38/38 passing (22 regression + 10 P1 + 6 new OG). Frontend Playwright run from Results page confirmed share-btn opens share-modal, share-preview loads the 1200x630 PNG (naturalWidth=1200, naturalHeight=630), share-native / share-download / share-copy-link are all present and clickable without JS errors, and share-close hides the modal. Both carryover issues from iter 2 are now fixed: ZERO Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings and ZERO 'Maximum update depth' warnings in the console across Results + History. Chart bounding boxes measured 180 (results) and 256 (history x2) as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: og_router.render_session_card reads session dict by hard-keys (session['domain'], session['topic'], session['difficulty'], session['wpm'], session['accuracy'], session['duration_seconds'], session['created_at']). A legacy/partial session that's missing any of these will raise KeyError and FastAPI will 500 instead of 404 or graceful fallback. Consider .get() with sensible defaults for domain/topic/difficulty/created_at the same way raw_wpm and incorrect_chars are handled.

OG png endpoint is explicitly PUBLIC by design (confirmed in request brief) - any UUID can render its card. This is fine for social scrapers, but it means an attacker can enumerate session UUIDs to read minimal metadata (domain/topic/wpm/accuracy/time) without auth. Mitigations if ever needed: signed short-lived URLs, or an opt-in 'sharing enabled' flag per session. Acceptable as-is given v4-UUID entropy.

ShareModal.onNativeShare silently falls back to navigator.clipboard on browsers without navigator.share - good. On browsers that block clipboard (e.g. non-secure contexts, headless CI) it surfaces a toast 'clipboard blocked.' - also good. No regression.
Practice.jsx wraps handleLiveStats in useCallback([], []) - verified: 0 'Maximum update depth' console warnings after live render on Results page. TypingArena onLiveStats effect is now stable.

Results.jsx and History.jsx use explicit numeric height on ResponsiveContainer (180, 256, 256). Verified via bounding box measurement and console: 0 width(-1)/height(-1) Recharts warnings. Iter 1 + iter 2 carryover is resolved.

og_router uses Pillow's `optimize=True` on each request, which re-runs zlib compression on every call. For hot sessions this is slightly wasteful; caching by session id (or using Cache-Control already set to 86400 at the edge) mitigates, but adding a simple in-memory LRU on the raw PNG bytes keyed by (session_id, wpm, accuracy, incorrect_chars) would save ~150-300ms per rebuild. Optional perf nit.
